description: Searches vertodigital.com and returns matches as markdown. scope sets what is searched: "pages" (default) is every page, blog posts, ebooks, events and case studies included; "case_studies" is client results, one line each with the headline stat; "offer" matches a buyer's challenge to the services that fit, with proof points and reasons to choose VertoDigital. Each query word must start a word in an entry ("attribut" finds "attribution"); "offer" also takes a full sentence. Omit query to list the whole scope. No match returns match_count 0 and a hint. Read results with vertodigital_get_page.

query.description: Keywords such as "LinkedIn Ads" or "HubSpot"; for scope "offer", a challenge in plain words.

section.description: Scope "pages" only: a section heading to keep, e.g. "Services" or "Blog".

name: vertodigital_search_site

match_count.description: null when no query was given
